proposals.expected_signal: A message-transform graph with a contrastive auxiliary should test whether lightweight semantic denoising plus residual neighborhood mixing can lift top-10 ranking quality beyond the weak latent-style
proposals.failure_mode: Transformer-style message mixing may overfit sparse user-item graphs on ML-1M and the auxiliary may dominate pairwise ranking, producing smoother embeddings but no NDCG@10 gain.
proposals.hypothesis: If user-item propagation is upgraded from plain factor interactions to message-transformed graph updates, then adding a cross-view contrastive auxiliary between shallow and deep propagated views will improve representation quality under frozen full-sort evaluation while remaining runnable in a pilot setting.
